system.notes:
DocWagon client medical records and contract management. Tier-3 contract holders have full medical history, trauma protocol, and extraction team assignments stored here. The DS is partition-locked on Platinum-tier client data.

Notable data: Medical files, extraction contract tiers, billing records, pharmaceutical orders. Particularly valuable for tracking a high-profile target's extraction schedule.

nodes.name: System Access Node
nodes.description: Client-facing portal. Handles contract lookups, emergency beacon registration, and billing inquiries.

nodes.name: I/O Port
nodes.description: Medical intake terminal. Hardlined to DocWagon Seattle HQ dispatch desk only. Staff-use only.

nodes.name: Sub-Processing Unit
nodes.description: Routes dispatch requests, medical data queries, and team assignment updates.

nodes.name: Slave Node
nodes.description: Controls emergency beacon transponders, DocWagon vehicle GPS trackers, and response team comm units.

nodes.name: Data Store — Client Records
nodes.description: Medical histories, trauma protocols, extraction contract tiers, and emergency contact data for all active contract holders.

nodes.name: Data Store — Pharmaceutical
nodes.description: Pharmaceutical supply orders, controlled substance authorisations, and trauma kit inventories. Partition-locked for Platinum clients.

nodes.name: Central Processing Unit
nodes.description: Administers team dispatch, security sheaf, and the encrypted Platinum-tier client partition. Any breach triggers DocWagon's legal response team.

ioPorts.name: Dispatch Desk Terminal
ioPorts.physicalLocation: DocWagon Seattle HQ, 2nd floor dispatch centre. Hardlined terminal at each of the 6 dispatch workstations. Requires staff SIN and passcode.

triggerSteps.label: TS 1
triggerSteps.description: Alert (Passive) triggers. DocWagon Security Operations Centre receives automated page. On-call sysop begins remote investigation. HIPAA-equivalent regulations mandate a breach response within 15 minutes.

triggerSteps.label: TS 2
triggerSteps.description: Authenticator deploys at SAN. All active sessions re-challenged. Forged medical professional credentials will be detected and flagged to DocWagon legal.

triggerSteps.label: TS 3
triggerSteps.description: Scrambler activates on DS-A. Client medical data is re-encrypted mid-session. Any active download is corrupted. Decryption requires Exploit roll vs TN 5.

triggerSteps.label: TS 4
triggerSteps.description: Tracker deploys. Logs full movement history across the host. Data transmitted to DocWagon legal team and copied to law enforcement liaison. This creates a paper trail that survives even if the decker escapes.

triggerSteps.label: TS 5
triggerSteps.description: Dataworm activates targeting the intruder's persona. Begins corrupting active program files — roll Cybercombat each pass or lose a program rating point. Priority target: any Decrypt or Exploit programs.

triggerSteps.label: TS 6
triggerSteps.description: DS-B partition lock reinforced. Platinum client data sealed behind an additional 2-factor challenge. SN beacon network updated to flag the intruder's physical location if DocWagon vehicles are in range.

triggerSteps.label: TS 7
triggerSteps.description: CPU switches to emergency protocols. All non-essential processes suspended. DocWagon response team scrambled — physical security sweep of all registered jackpoint locations within 1km.

triggerSteps.label: TS 8
triggerSteps.description: Full data lockdown. DS-A and DS-B both sealed. I/O port access revoked. Lone Star notified with full breach packet. DocWagon contracts typically include a 'hostile hacker' clause for extraction revocation.

triggerSteps.label: TS 9
triggerSteps.description: Convergence. GOD response. Any active DocWagon contract held by the decker's registered SIN is immediately suspended pending investigation. Physical location transmitted to Lone Star and DocWagon security.
